description:
## Why
`:erlang.error(:boom)` fails to resolve (resolve/unknown-import: module :erlang does not export error/1). Elixir code raises a plain value with it, and fz's panic/1 already has its semantics (ErlangError when rescued, the raw value under catch :error). Four oracle fixtures can only become their own oracle once it exists: 00705, 00819, 00846, 00847.

## What changes
:erlang.error/1 is exported and behaves exactly as panic/1 on every path. Whether panic/1 then remains is not decided here.

## Signal
The four fixtures, rewritten to call :erlang.error, print their goldens on run, interp and build.
title: :erlang.error/1 raises its value as panic/1 does
